title: Hardcoded volatile Cloud Run host has no config/drift guard despite admitted brittleness
evidence:
+    "connect-src 'self' https://www.google.com https://mpc2-prod-23-is5qnl632q-ue.a.run.app",
+///     transport endpoint from the container config served through the
+///     `/_gads_assets` proxy; it never appears in our code. The host is the
+///     container's generated Cloud Run URL — stable across revisions, changes
+///     only if the sGTM container is ever recreated (this line must follow).
detail: A generated Cloud Run URL is hardcoded into connect-src; the diff admits it changes when the sGTM container is recreated, but ships no env/config override or drift test. Recreation silently breaks ad tracking, and CSP report-uri won't catch a stale-but-allowed host.
recommended_fix: Drive the host from an env/config value, or add a startup/Sentry drift check so container recreation is caught before the CSP_ENFORCE flip.

title: Regional Google pixel domains only partially allowlisted by the diff's own admission
evidence:
+    "img-src 'self' data: https://www.google.com https://www.facebook.com https://www.google.ie https://www.google.com.gh",
+///     Ads conversion pixels fire on the user's regional Google domain. More
+///     regional domains (google.co.uk, …) will surface as visitors come from
+///     other countries — each is a one-line addition here.
detail: Enforcement-prep adds only google.ie and google.com.gh; the diff admits other regional domains will surface and are not added, so enforcement would block ad conversion pixels for every un-listed region.
recommended_fix: Either enumerate known high-traffic regional Google domains now, or require zero new regional violations for N days before flipping CSP_ENFORCE.
